about: Error names that the state machines match in a Retry or Catch. A name from a Step Functions SDK integration is not the name in the AWS API reference: the same RestoreAlreadyInProgress arrived as S3.S3Exception. So every name other than the built-in matchers must be listed here, either as observed in a real run or, with a reason, as not observed. tests/test_asl_error_names.py fails on a name in neither list.

S3.S3Exception.record: 2026-11-26 first run, raw record s9-restore-error-names: second RestoreObject on the same object, HTTP 409 'Object restore is already in progress', returned by the SDK integration as Error=S3.S3Exception

InvalidInput.record: 2026-11-26 second run, raw record s3-input-refusals: a reused runId and a production start without requestedBy were returned by the plan Lambda function as errorType=InvalidInput

not_observed.Lambda.ServiceException: Step Functions documents these four as the transient Lambda errors to retry. No run produced one
not_observed.S3ApHelperError: raised by shared/s3ap_helper.py for an Access Point error; the retry on it was not exercised by an injected failure in a real run
not_observed.InvalidConfiguration: raised by the plan and select functions for a stack configuration error; no run had one
not_observed.S3.SdkClientException: SDK integration client error on copyObject; none occurred
not_observed.S3.SlowDownException: throttling answer of S3; the SDK integration's name for it was not observed and may differ, as it did for the restore request
not_observed.S3.RestoreAlreadyInProgressException: the modelled name. The real run returned S3.S3Exception, so this entry never matched; it stays in front of the S3.S3Exception catch in case the integration returns the modelled name in another release
not_observed.ECS.AmazonECSException: documented error of ecs:runTask.sync; no Fargate task failed to start in the runs
